fees.title: Taskers Fees & Pricing
fees.subtitle: Simple, transparent pricing designed to reward loyal taskers

structure.title: Tasker Fee Structure
structure.description: At BitTasker, we believe in rewarding loyalty. The more tasks you complete, the less you pay in fees. Our dynamic tier system ensures that our most active taskers enjoy the best rates.
structure.note: Save money as you use BitTasker! Our unique tier system rewards active taskees with progressively lower fees.

fees.savingsTitle: Save money as you use BitTasker!
fees.savingsDescription: Our unique tier system rewards active taskers with progressively lower fees.
fees.label: Fee Rate

tier1.title:
Nakamoto
Newbie
tier1.description: For taskers posting and completing 0-3 tasks in the last 30 days
tier1.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll pay $112.50 total (plus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

tier2.title:
Satoshi
Stacker
tier2.description: For taskers posting and completing 4-10 tasks in the last 30 days
tier2.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll pay $110 total (plus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

tier3.title:
Hash
Master
tier3.description: For our most active taskers posting and completing 11+ tasks in the last 30 days
tier3.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll pay $107.50 total (plus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

btc.title: Bitcoin Payments: Lower Fees, Same Great Service
btc.description: Save even more when you pay with Bitcoin! We offer reduced rates for taskers who choose to use Bitcoin.

rebooking.btc_example: Bitcoin Example: As a Hash Master tier tasker, a $100 task paid with Bitcoin would cost just $101.50 total!

rebooking.title: Rebooking Discount
rebooking.description: Love working with a particular taskee? We reward repeat partnerships with significantly reduced fees!
rebooking.card_intro: When you rebook a taskee you've worked with before:
rebooking.example: Example: Rebooking a $100 task costs just $103 with standard payment or $101 with Bitcoin!
rebooking.counts_toward_tier: Booking repeat work with a taskee counts towards your 30 day rolling tasks to maintain your tier.

benefits.title: Tasker Benefits & Visibility
benefits.description: Higher tier taskers enjoy additional benefits beyond reduced fees:
benefits.badge: Badge Recognition: Earn prestigious tier badges displayed on your profile
benefits.priority: Priority Attention: Higher tier taskers may receive more proposals from top taskees
benefits.profile: Enhanced Profile: Your tier status signals to taskees that you're an active and trusted tasker
